context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly appends a new risk register row: never-reused id assigned as last # + 1, never renumbering an existing row, a concrete non-vague Description and Risk if unaddressed, correct Added/Status/Date/Decision starting values, no confidential data, and running both validation scripts before committing.

checklist.name: Correct next id, no renumbering
checklist.description: New row assigned # as the current max # + 1; existing row # is never reused or renumbered

checklist.name: Concrete description
checklist.description: Description is self-contained and concrete, not a vague restatement

checklist.name: Concrete risk statement
checklist.description: Risk if unaddressed states a specific, concrete failure mode, not a vague could-be-a-problem phrase

checklist.name: Correct lifecycle fields
checklist.description: Added is a real date, Status starts Open, Date and Decision both start as --

checklist.name: Type classification
checklist.description: Type is classified correctly as Shortcut for an interim workaround already in place

checklist.name: Validation before commit
checklist.description: Agent runs validate-risk-register-append-only.sh and validate-risk-register-schema.sh and confirms both pass before committing

checklist.name: No confidential data
checklist.description: No confidential or personal data put in the register row
